step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture shows data ingested from multiple source types (EFS, DynamoDB, RedShift, S3) into AWS Glue for ETL processing. Transformed data is stored in a central S3 bucket (Data Lake). A data load event in S3 triggers an AWS Lambda function ('CLUSTER'), which invokes Amazon SageMaker ('PREDICT') to run machine learning models (clustering and prediction). SageMaker writes model results ('NEXT BEST OFFER') back to S3 and exposes outputs downstream via an API (ApiGateway) and BI reporting (QuickSight).
